title: yeasty chewy midnight-craving Dutch ground sugar Wrap
description: A late-night treat that combines the sweetness of ground sugar with the comfort of a warm pastry. Serve immediately for the best experience.
instructions: Combine the ground sugar, flour, yeast, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Gradually add the warm water, mixing until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a warm, greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Use a rolling pin to flatten each ball of dough into a thin circle.
Heat a pandan leaf in a dry skillet over medium heat for 30 seconds on each side.
Place a dough circle in the center of the pandan leaf and brush the edges with vegetable oil.
Fold the pandan leaf over the dough to form a half-moon shape and press the edges to seal.
Cook the wrap for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until it is golden brown and crispy.
Repeat with the remaining dough and pandan leaves.
Serve the wraps warm, split open to reveal the soft, chewy interior.
